business_problem: CITIC Financial Holdings needed to make its wealth-management platform more intelligent and scenario-driven so customer-service and wealth-adviser interactions could scale across a very large client base.
solution_summary: CITIC Financial Holdings and Baidu AI Cloud upgraded the group's wealth-management collaboration platform with a large-model customer-service and adviser layer. The implementation uses Baidu AI Cloud Keyue as the conversational surface and organizes its improvement work into three linked knowledge loops: knowledge expansion, knowledge tuning and the knowledge flywheel. Knowledge expansion uses FAQ mining and task-oriented dialogue techniques to broaden the wealth-adviser knowledge base and cover more service scenarios. Knowledge tuning uses expanded-question generation and semantic-confusion detection to improve intent recognition and raise answer precision. The flywheel layer then closes the loop by feeding knowledge expansion and optimization back into continuing operations. Rather than treating the platform as static FAQ automation, CITIC turned it into an iteratively improved digital-wealth-assistant stack that sits on top of an existing group-wide wealth-management platform and helps advisers and customers interact more effectively.

solution_components.name: Baidu AI Cloud Keyue
solution_components.role: Acts as the intelligent customer-service and wealth-assistant front end for user conversations.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Expansion Scheme
solution_components.role: Uses FAQ mining and task dialogue to broaden the service knowledge base.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Tuning Scheme
solution_components.role: Improves intent recognition and response quality through semantic optimization.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Flywheel
solution_components.role: Creates a continuous operational loop for expanding and optimizing service knowledge.

data_flow: Customer and adviser questions enter the Keyue conversational layer, where expanded and tuned knowledge assets are used to classify intent, retrieve wealth-service answers and feed improvements back into the knowledge flywheel.
business_outcome: CITIC improved the quality and scalability of digital wealth-service conversations and created a knowledge-operations loop that can keep expanding as new scenarios are added.
